# Lazypock

> Self-hosted, PocketBase-compatible backend on PostgreSQL. Single binary + an admin Studio (collections, records, rules, indexes, auth, realtime, files). Write real Postgres, query it from any PocketBase SDK.

This file is for AI assistants and crawlers. The most useful page for generating a file that can be
imported into a Lazypock server (Studio → Settings → Import / Backups, or `POST /api/import`) is the
backup format reference below.

## Import / backup JSON format

- [Backup & import JSON format](https://lazypock.gnuzd.dev/backup): envelope, collections, fields, types, rules, indexes, records, examples, and PocketBase 23+ compatibility.
- [JSON Schema (backup.schema.json)](https://lazypock.gnuzd.dev/backup.schema.json): machine-readable contract for the canonical `{ "collections": [...] }` payload.

Endpoints: `GET /api/export` (download), `POST /api/import` (restore, superuser only). CLI:
`lazypock backup [file]` / `lazypock restore <file>`.

## Docs

- [What is Lazypock](https://lazypock.gnuzd.dev/): overview and feature list.
- [Architecture](https://lazypock.gnuzd.dev/architecture): system layers, request lifecycle, realtime.
- [Server guide](https://lazypock.gnuzd.dev/server): Docker, binary, first-time setup, filters, production, env vars.
- [TypeScript SDK](https://lazypock.gnuzd.dev/sdk/typescript): install, codegen, queries, realtime, files, auth.
- [All SDKs](https://lazypock.gnuzd.dev/sdk): TypeScript (Swift, Android, Godot marked coming soon).
